item.title: CUTTO 0.5.0 for Windows
item.description:
First public CUTTO release for Windows x64.
- Prepare talking-head projects and edit them through CUTTO MCP in DaVinci Resolve. - Includes the desktop interface, email-code sign-in, local models, FFmpeg, and a private Bridge runtime. - User-initiated signed updates with a per-user installer. - Includes the CUTTO end-user licence agreement.
For the first installation, extract the complete ZIP to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CUTTO and launch CUTTO.exe. Install Bridge, then save and reopen DaVinci Resolve. Do not run the update installer to bootstrap an older unowned installation.
The app and installer do not have an Authenticode certificate; Windows may show a security warning. Do not disable Windows security. Validated on the Acer editor machine with DaVinci Resolve Free 21.0.2.4. Windows project-data cleanup and broader compatibility validation remain unavailable.
